limitations: No real PCB or switch-matrix electrical test yet.
No real BLE split radio test yet.
Pointing-device driver intentionally not enabled in RC3.
This sandbox has no network access to clone the ZMK/Zephyr source tree, so the authoritative west build must run in GitHub Actions or another networked ZMK toolchain.
changes_from_rc1: Updated XIAO BLE board ID from legacy seeeduino_xiao_ble to xiao_ble//zmk.
Moved shield hardware definition from config/boards/shields to boards/shields.
Replaced unsupported shared split .conf with splitchoc64_left.conf and splitchoc64_right.conf.
Removed legacy CONFIG_NFCT_PINS_AS_GPIOS assumption from RC1.
Workflow now follows current ZMK reusable build workflow on main.
changes_from_rc2: Added zephyr/module.yml so top-level boards/shields is discovered by the current ZMK reusable build workflow.
Changed the Menu key binding from undefined K_APP to current ZMK keycode K_MENU.
Removed CONFIG_ZMK_SLEEP from both halves during pre-hardware validation to avoid making RC3 dependent on current-main split-central sleep behavior.
Added tools/validate_rc3.py for deterministic repository-level static checks.
changes_from_rc3: Added build.settings.board_root: . to zephyr/module.yml so Zephyr discovers boards/shields/splitchoc64.
changes_from_rc5: Added root #address-cells=<1> and #size-cells=<0> to LEFT/RIGHT overlays so zmk,analog-stick-split reg=<0> uses the one-cell format expected by the driver.
changes_from_rc6: Renamed analog_stick_split0 to analog_stick_split@0 so the node unit address matches reg=<0> under Zephyr 4.1 dtc.
changes_from_rc7: Registered the SplitChoc64 repository as a Zephyr CMake module.
Added a compile-time compatibility alias mapping legacy zmk_endpoints_send_mouse_report to current zmk_endpoint_send_mouse_report for zmk-driver-analog-stick.
changes_from_rc8: Removed the RC9 global INPUT_CALLBACK_DEFINE compatibility wrapper because it affected every target, including settings_reset.
Relies on the current upstream zmk-driver-analog-stick built-in Zephyr 3.5/4.x INPUT_CALLBACK_DEFINE compatibility.
Retains only the endpoint helper alias zmk_endpoints_send_mouse_report -> zmk_endpoint_send_mouse_report.
Uses refs/heads/main for the analog-stick dependency to make branch refresh explicit.
changes_from_rc10: Locally patches only zmk-driver-analog-stick/input_split.c so Zephyr 4.1 uses the 3-argument INPUT_CALLBACK_DEFINE form.
Scopes split-proxy address cells inside a dedicated container to avoid changing root /soc addressing.
changes_from_rc11: Restored #address-cells=<1> and #size-cells=<0> inside &adc, as required for ADC child channel reg=<0>/<1>.
Removed the accidental root-level address/size override.
Retained the RC11 local Zephyr 4.1 patch for the analog-stick driver's input_split.c.
Retained the dedicated joy_splits container for split-proxy reg addressing.
changes_from_previous: RIGHT now emits standard INPUT_EV_REL X/Y events from SAADC.
RIGHT forwards those events using ZMK native zmk,input-split.
LEFT receives the split proxy and sends HID using native zmk,input-listener.
Removed all custom ZMK API compatibility patches.
JOY_SW remains reserved for a later RC.
changes_from_rc13: Enabled ZMK Studio only on the LEFT/central build.
Added Base/Fn display names plus two reserved Studio layers.
Kept the RC13 JOY2765 ADC/input-split architecture unchanged.
